claim.text: Impact occurred 1.17 s after the vehicle became a hazard.
At hazard onset the time-to-collision was 1.92 s, with the struck vehicle closing within the ego lane.
Perception took 0.16 s from hazard onset to first detection, below the 0.30 s threshold.
Command took 0.06 s from first detection to brake request, below the 0.10 s threshold.
Brake actuation took 0.68 s from CAN brake request to pressure reached, above the 0.25 s threshold.
With nominal perception of 0.20 s, nominal command of 0.05 s and nominal tau of 0.15 s, the replay avoids contact with a minimum gap of 0.59 m.
The brake log is complete, with a maximum brake gap of 0.02 s.
The other vehicle's brake lights were illuminated, confirmed by an independent recheck of the hazard window.
Brake actuation is the primary contributing factor, as it exceeds its threshold while the nominal-timing replay avoids contact.
